description: Activate or resume recurring weekly or monthly tool calls. maxCostMicroPerRun must equal the tracker's latest estimatedCostMicroPerRun; activation authorizes future billed calls until paused. The response includes the balance, the cost per run, and runsDryAt, the date the balance stops covering active trackers. When tracker emails are enabled, activation sends a setup summary and every completed run sends current results and suggested next steps, even when nothing changed. Activation is refused when the balance cannot cover the next run. Managing trackers and reading reports is free; each run bills one call per prompt at the per-surface rates.

maxCostMicroPerRun.description: Exact estimatedCostMicroPerRun returned by the latest tracker record.

trackerId.description: Cite42 tracker ID returned by a tracker management or report tool.

name: cite42_tracker_activate
